source.text: Γνωρίζω δὲ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, ὃ καὶ παρελάβετε, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἑστήκατε, δι’ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε, τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, εἰ κατέχετε, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ εἰκῇ ἐπιστεύσατε.

records.literal_gloss: I make known but to you, brothers, the gospel which I proclaimed to you, which also you received, in which also you stand, \v 2 through which also you are being saved, with what word I proclaimed [it] to you, if you hold fast, unless in vain you believed.

en.L: Now I make known to you, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, the gospel that I proclaimed to you, which you also received, in which you also stand, \v 2 through which you are also being saved, with what message I proclaimed [it] to you, if you are holding [it] fast, unless you believed in vain.
en.B: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I am setting out for you once more the gospel I proclaimed to you. You received it, you stand firm in it, \v 2 and through it you are being saved, if you keep hold of the message as I proclaimed it to you. Otherwise you came to believe for nothing.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, let me remind you of the good news I told you. You accepted it, and you are standing firm in it. \v 2 Through it God is saving you, as long as you hold on to the message just as I told it to you. If you do not, your believing was for nothing.

fr.L: Or je vous fais connaître, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, l’Évangile que je vous ai annoncé, que vous avez aussi reçu, dans lequel aussi vous tenez ferme, \v 2 par lequel aussi vous êtes sauvés, en quels termes je vous [l’]ai annoncé, si vous [le] retenez, à moins que vous n’ayez cru pour rien.
fr.B: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je vous expose une fois encore l’Évangile que je vous ai annoncé. Vous l’avez reçu, vous y tenez ferme, \v 2 et par lui vous êtes en train d’être sauvés, si vous gardez le message tel que je vous l’ai annoncé. Sinon, vous avez cru pour rien.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je veux vous rappeler la bonne nouvelle que je vous ai annoncée. Vous l’avez acceptée, et vous tenez ferme en elle. \v 2 Par elle, Dieu est en train de vous sauver, à condition que vous restiez attachés au message tel que je vous l’ai annoncé. Sinon, vous avez cru pour rien.

es.L: Ahora bien, {{plural_you:les|os}} hago saber, hermanos, el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié, que también {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, en el cual también {{plural_you:están firmes|estáis firmes}}, \v 2 por medio del cual también {{plural_you:están siendo salvados|estáis siendo salvados}}, con qué palabra {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié [el evangelio], si [lo] {{plural_you:retienen|retenéis}}, a no ser que {{plural_you:hayan creído|hayáis creído}} en vano.
es.B: Hermanos, quiero {{plural_you:recordarles|recordaros}} el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié. {{plural_you:Ustedes lo recibieron|Vosotros lo recibisteis}} y en él {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes, \v 2 y por medio de él {{plural_you:están siendo salvados|estáis siendo salvados}}, si {{plural_you:se aferran|os aferráis}} al mensaje tal como yo {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} anuncié. De lo contrario, {{plural_you:habrán|habréis}} creído en vano.
es.R: Hermanos, quiero {{plural_you:recordarles|recordaros}} la buena noticia que {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncié. {{plural_you:Ustedes la aceptaron|Vosotros la aceptasteis}} y {{plural_you:se mantienen|os mantenéis}} firmes en ella. \v 2 Por medio de ella Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} está salvando, siempre que {{plural_you:se aferren|os aferréis}} al mensaje tal como yo {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} anuncié. Si no lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, {{plural_you:habrán|habréis}} creído para nada.

sw.L: Basi nawajulisha, ndugu, Injili niliyowahubiria, ambayo pia mliipokea, ambayo pia mmesimama ndani yake, \v 2 ambayo kupitia hiyo pia mnaokolewa, ikiwa mnalishika kwa uthabiti neno lile nililowahubiria, isipokuwa mliamini bure.
sw.B: Ndugu, nataka kuwaeleza tena Injili niliyowahubiria. Mliipokea, nanyi mmesimama imara ndani yake, \v 2 na kupitia hiyo mnaokolewa, ikiwa mnashika kwa uthabiti ujumbe kama nilivyowahubiria. La sivyo, mliamini bure.
sw.R: Ndugu, nataka kuwakumbusha habari njema niliyowaambia. Mliipokea, nanyi mmesimama imara ndani yake. \v 2 Kupitia habari njema hiyo Mungu anawaokoa, ikiwa mnaushika ujumbe huo kama nilivyowaambia. Msipoushika, kuamini kwenu kulikuwa bure.

decisions.choice: I make known: here, I set out again what they already know, as the ground for the argument that follows
decisions.reason: Γνωρίζω usually means to make something known, but the Corinthians have already received this gospel and stand in it (verses 1-2). Paul restates it so that he can build on it in verses 12-34.

decisions.choice: are being saved: salvation as something under way, to be completed at the end
alternatives: are saved, as a finished state
decisions.reason: σῴζεσθε is present tense, as in 1:18 ("us who are being saved"). The salvation that began when they believed reaches its goal at the resurrection, the subject of this chapter.

decisions.choice: if you hold fast: the condition is that they keep hold of the message in the form in which Paul proclaimed it
alternatives: "I make known ... in what words I proclaimed it", taking the phrase with the opening verb
decisions.reason: The order of τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν εἰ κατέχετε is unusual, with the question word placed before the condition. Read with κατέχετε ("you hold fast"), it says what they must keep hold of: the gospel as Paul put it to them, which he now repeats in verses 3-5.

decisions.choice: in vain: to no purpose, a faith that would come to nothing
decisions.reason: εἰκῇ can mean either. Verses 14 and 17 show what Paul has in mind: faith would be empty and futile if Christ had not been raised. He does not think this is so; the clause sharpens the warning against denying the resurrection.

decisions.choice: I am setting out for you once more
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that Paul is restating what they already know (m1); Readable says "let me remind you".

decisions.choice: God is saving you
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who saves, which the passive leaves unstated.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the readers, as elsewhere in the letter
decisions.reason: As in English, the church is addressed as men and women together; "frères" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: l’Évangile (L, B); la bonne nouvelle (R)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As in Colossians (style guide 9): Readable says "good news" because "Évangile" is church language; the capital marks the message itself.

decisions.choice: el evangelio (L, B); la buena noticia (R) (chapter 15)
quiero recordarles
decisions.reason: The verb "make known" here sets out again what they already know (m1). Balanced says "recordar", as the English "setting out for you once more"; Literal keeps "hacer saber".

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
decisions.reason: As 1:10: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the English gender spans in this chapter (verses 1, 6, 50, 58) have no Swahili counterpart; nor do those on "watu" and "mtu".

decisions.choice: mnaokolewa
decisions.reason: The Swahili present "-na-" says that salvation is under way, to be completed at the end (meaning decision), as the English "are being saved"; the perfect "mmeokolewa" would say it is already complete.

source.text: Παρέδωκα γὰρ ὑμῖν ἐν πρώτοις, ὃ καὶ παρέλαβον, ὅτι Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν κατὰ τὰς γραφάς, καὶ ὅτι ἐτάφη, καὶ ὅτι ἐγήγερται τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ κατὰ τὰς γραφάς, καὶ ὅτι ὤφθη Κηφᾷ, εἶτα τοῖς δώδεκα·

records.literal_gloss: I handed on for to you among first [things], what also I received, that Christ died for the sins of us according to the scriptures, \v 4 and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the day the third according to the scriptures, \v 5 and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve;

en.L: For I handed on to you among [the] first things what I also received: that {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} died for our sins according to the Scriptures, \v 4 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was buried, and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, \v 5 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.
en.B: What I handed on to you, as the first and chief thing, I myself had received: that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} died for our sins, in keeping with the Scriptures; \v 4 that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was buried; that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised on the third day, in keeping with the Scriptures; \v 5 and that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to Cephas, and after that to the Twelve.
en.R: I passed on to you the most important message of all, the one that was passed on to me. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said would happen. \v 4 He was buried. God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life on the third day, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is alive, just as the Scriptures said. \v 5 He appeared to Peter, and then to the Twelve, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} closest followers.

fr.L: Car je vous ai transmis, parmi les premières [choses], ce que j’ai aussi reçu : que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés selon les Écritures, \v 4 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été enseveli, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité le troisième jour selon les Écritures, \v 5 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Céphas, puis aux Douze.
fr.B: Ce que je vous ai transmis en tout premier lieu, je l’avais moi-même reçu : que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés, conformément aux Écritures ; \v 4 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été enseveli ; qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité le troisième jour, conformément aux Écritures ; \v 5 et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Céphas, et ensuite aux Douze.
fr.R: Je vous ai transmis le message le plus important de tous, celui que j’avais moi-même reçu. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est mort pour nos péchés, comme les Écritures l’avaient annoncé. \v 4 Il a été mis au tombeau. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité le troisième jour, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vivant, comme l’annonçaient les Écritures. \v 5 Il est apparu à Pierre, puis aux Douze, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples les plus proches.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} entregué en primer lugar lo que también yo recibí: que {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados conforme a las Escrituras, \v 4 y que fue sepultado, y que ha sido resucitado al tercer día conforme a las Escrituras, \v 5 y que se apareció a Cefas, luego a los Doce.
es.B: Lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} transmití como lo primero y más importante es lo que yo mismo había recibido: que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados, de acuerdo con las Escrituras; \v 4 que fue sepultado; que ha sido resucitado al tercer día, de acuerdo con las Escrituras; \v 5 y que se apareció a Cefas, y después a los Doce.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} transmití el mensaje más importante de todos, el mismo que me transmitieron a mí. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} murió por nuestros pecados, tal como habían dicho las Escrituras. \v 4 Fue sepultado. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó al tercer día, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está vivo, tal como dicen las Escrituras. \v 5 Se apareció a Pedro, y después a los Doce, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos más cercanos.

sw.L: Kwa maana niliwakabidhi miongoni mwa mambo ya kwanza kile nilichopokea pia: kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu kulingana na Maandiko, \v 4 na kwamba alizikwa, na kwamba amefufuliwa siku ya tatu kulingana na Maandiko, \v 5 na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.B: Kile nilichowakabidhi kama jambo la kwanza na kuu, mimi mwenyewe nilikuwa nimekipokea: kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema; \v 4 kwamba alizikwa; kwamba amefufuliwa siku ya tatu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema; \v 5 na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.R: Niliwapa ujumbe ulio muhimu kuliko yote, ule ambao mimi nami nilipewa. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama Maandiko yalivyosema ingetokea. \v 4 Alizikwa. Mungu alimfufua siku ya tatu, na sasa yu hai, kama Maandiko yalivyosema. \v 5 Alimtokea Petro, kisha mitume kumi na wawili, wafuasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa karibu.

decisions.choice: handed on ... received: the words for passing on a tradition faithfully, from teacher to learner
decisions.reason: Παρέδωκα and παρέλαβον are the pair Paul uses for the Lord's Supper in 11:23 and for the traditions in 11:2, and ὑπὲρ in verse 1 is the Corinthians' side of it. The lines that follow, each beginning with ὅτι ("that"), read like a fixed summary Paul was taught and taught in turn. He also says that his gospel came to him by revelation (Galatians 1:11-12); the two do not conflict, since what he was taught agreed with what the risen Lord showed him.

decisions.choice: among the first things: as of first importance, the heart of the gospel
alternatives: first in time, the first thing I taught you
decisions.reason: ἐν πρώτοις can mean first in order of time or first in importance. Both may be meant: this was where Paul began, and it is what everything else rests on.

decisions.choice: according to the Scriptures: Christ's death for sins and his being raised happened as the Scriptures of Israel said, without one passage being named
decisions.reason: Paul names no text. For a death "for our sins", the clearest candidate is Isaiah 53:4-12, where the servant bears the sins of many. For the raising, Psalm 16:10 is used of Jesus' resurrection in Acts 2:25-31, and some connect "on the third day" with Hosea 6:2 or with Jonah 1:17 (compare Matthew 12:40). It is not certain whether the second phrase goes with "on the third day" or with the raising as a whole.

decisions.choice: has been raised: raised once and still alive
alternatives: was raised, as a past event only
decisions.reason: The other verbs in the list, ἀπέθανεν ("died"), ἐτάφη ("was buried") and ὤφθη ("appeared"), look back on single events. ἐγήγερται alone is a perfect: Christ was raised and lives now. Paul keeps this tense all through verses 12-20. The passive means that God raised him (verse 15).

decisions.choice: was buried: his death was real and complete
decisions.reason: Burial confirms death. The four lines go together in pairs: he died and was buried; he was raised and was seen.

decisions.choice: Cephas is Peter; the Twelve is the name of the group Jesus chose
decisions.reason: Cephas is the Aramaic name Jesus gave Peter (John 1:42), as in 1:12. "The Twelve" was the group's name even when Judas was no longer among them; Luke 24:33 speaks of "the Eleven" at this point.

decisions.choice: follow the SBLGNT: "the Twelve"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts, mainly Western witnesses, read "the Eleven", which looks like a correction to account for Judas. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: What I handed on to you ... I myself had received
alternatives: For I handed on to you ... what I also received
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the same pattern as 11:23, putting the teaching they already have first.

decisions.choice: in keeping with the Scriptures
decisions.reason: Balanced says plainly that the events match what the Scriptures say; Literal keeps the traditional form. Readable says "just as the Scriptures said".

decisions.choice: God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life ... and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is alive; Peter; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} closest followers
alternatives: has been raised; Cephas; the Twelve
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who raised him and spells out the lasting result of the perfect (m4). It uses the name Peter, as the book does at Readable (1:12), and says who the Twelve were.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, with the article outside the span at every level
decisions.reason: "Messie" needs the article in French, and "le Christ" reads naturally too, so the article stands outside the span (style guide 7). Literal adds it without brackets, as in Colossians, although the Greek has none.

decisions.choice: il a été ressuscité (L, B); Dieu l’a ressuscité (R); la résurrection, ressusciter, throughout the chapter
decisions.reason: The passive keeps God as the one who raises, as the English "has been raised" does, and the perfect of the Greek, raised once and still alive (m4), is carried by the passé composé. "Il est ressuscité", the usual French, makes Christ the subject of an intransitive verb. Readable names God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: entregar ... recibir (L); transmitir ... recibir (B); transmitir (R)
decisions.reason: The pair are the words for handing on a tradition faithfully (m1). Literal keeps "entregar", the plain sense of the Greek verb; Balanced and Readable say "transmitir", the Spanish word for passing on a teaching.

decisions.choice: ha sido resucitado (L, B); Dios lo resucitó (R) (chapter 15)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect means raised once and still alive (m4), so Literal and Balanced say "ha sido resucitado" each time it comes back in the chapter, as the English "has been raised"; Readable names God as the one who raised him and adds "está vivo". The noun is "resurrección" (L, B), and Readable says "resucitar".

decisions.choice: Cefas (L, B); Pedro (R); los Doce (L, B); los Doce, sus discípulos más cercanos (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:12 and 9:5 for Cephas. "Los Doce" is the name of the group; Readable explains it with "discípulos", never "seguidores".

decisions.choice: niliwakabidhi ... nilichopokea
decisions.reason: The pair for passing on a tradition faithfully (meaning decision): "kukabidhi" (hand over), the settled word for this verb, and "kupokea" (receive). Readable says simply "kuwapa ... nilipewa" (give, be given).

decisions.choice: amefufuliwa
decisions.reason: The Swahili perfect "ame-" says raised once and alive still (meaning decision), as the English "has been raised"; it is used for this form all through the chapter, with "ufufuo" for resurrection.

decisions.choice: Kefa (L, B); Petro (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice of 1:12; "wale Kumi na Wawili" (L, B) and "mitume kumi na wawili" (R) are the settled New Testament names for the Twelve.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: most pronouns for Christ and God in this chapter are prefixes inside the verb ("alizikwa", "alimtokea"), which cannot take a capital, so the English spans on he and him have no Swahili counterpart; "wake", "yake", "yeye", "kwake" and "mwenyewe" take the span.

source.text: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ, ἐξ ὧν οἱ πλείονες μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι, τινὲς δὲ ἐκοιμήθησαν·

records.literal_gloss: then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, of whom the most remain until now, some but fell asleep;

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} at one time, of whom the greater part remain until now, but some have fallen asleep.
en.B: Next {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} on a single occasion. Most of them are alive to this day, but some have died.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to more than 500 {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} at one time. Most of them are still alive today, but some have died.

fr.L: Ensuite {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à plus de 500 {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} à la fois, dont la plupart demeurent jusqu’à présent, mais quelques-uns se sont endormis.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à plus de 500 {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} en une seule fois. La plupart d’entre eux sont encore vivants aujourd’hui, mais quelques-uns sont morts.
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à plus de 500 {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} en même temps. La plupart d’entre eux sont encore en vie aujourd’hui, mais certains sont morts.

es.L: Después se apareció a más de 500 hermanos a la vez, de los cuales la mayoría permanece hasta ahora, pero algunos se han dormido.
es.B: Luego se apareció a más de 500 hermanos en una sola ocasión. La mayoría de ellos vive todavía, pero algunos ya han muerto.
es.R: Luego se apareció a más de 500 hermanos a la vez. La mayoría de ellos todavía están vivos, pero algunos han muerto.

sw.L: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa wakati mmoja, ambao wengi wao wangalipo hadi sasa, lakini wengine wamelala.
sw.B: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa pamoja. Wengi wao bado wako hai hadi leo, ingawa wengine wamefariki.
sw.R: Kisha akawatokea ndugu zaidi ya mia tano kwa wakati mmoja. Wengi wao bado wako hai leo, lakini baadhi yao wamekufa.

decisions.choice: brothers: fellow believers, men and women
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοῖς is Paul's usual word for members of the church, women included. Nothing limits this crowd to men, though ancient writers sometimes counted only the men in a crowd (Matthew 14:21).

decisions.choice: remain: are still alive
decisions.reason: Paul's point is that most of these witnesses can still be asked about what they saw.

decisions.choice: fell asleep: died
decisions.reason: ἐκοιμήθησαν is the gentle way of speaking of believers' death used in 7:39 and 11:30, which looks forward to waking at the resurrection, the subject of this chapter (verses 18, 20).

decisions.choice: have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m3), as at 7:39 and 11:30; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: se sont endormis (L); sont morts (B, R), and the same in 15:18 and 15:20
alternatives: se sont endormis at every level
decisions.reason: As in English, Literal keeps the idiom, which French also knows ("s’endormir dans la paix"); Balanced and Readable give its meaning (m3).

decisions.choice: se han dormido (L); han muerto (B, R) (chapter 15)
decisions.reason: "Falling asleep" is an idiom for dying (m3). Literal keeps "dormirse", as in 7:39, and Balanced and Readable say "morir"; the same holds in verses 18, 20 and 51.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 1:10: Spanish "hermanos" already includes women believers (m1).

decisions.choice: wamelala (L); wamefariki (B); wamekufa (R)
decisions.reason: As 7:39: Literal keeps the Greek picture of falling asleep, which Swahili Christian speech also uses for dying; Balanced "kufariki" and Readable "kufa" say it plainly, as the English does. The same pattern through chapter 15 (verses 18, 20, 51).

source.text: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ, εἶτα τοῖς ἀποστόλοις πᾶσιν·

records.literal_gloss: then he appeared to James, then to the apostles all;

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, and after him to all the apostles.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to James, the Lord's brother, and later to all the apostles.

fr.L: Ensuite {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, puis à tous les apôtres.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, et après lui à tous les apôtres.
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est apparu à Jacques, le frère du Seigneur, et plus tard à tous les apôtres.

es.L: Después se apareció a Santiago, luego a todos los apóstoles.
es.B: Luego se apareció a Santiago, y después a todos los apóstoles.
es.R: Luego se apareció a Santiago, el hermano del Señor, y más tarde a todos los apóstoles.

sw.L: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, kisha mitume wote.
sw.B: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, na baadaye mitume wote.
sw.R: Kisha akamtokea Yakobo, ndugu wa Bwana, na baadaye mitume wote.

decisions.choice: James: the brother of the Lord, later a leader of the church in Jerusalem
alternatives: James the son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve
decisions.reason: Paul calls this James "the Lord's brother" (Galatians 1:19) and names him among the pillars of the Jerusalem church (Galatians 2:9). Jesus' brothers did not believe in him during his ministry (John 7:5); an appearance to James helps explain the change. The son of Zebedee was already among the Twelve (verse 5).

decisions.choice: all the apostles: a wider group than the Twelve
decisions.reason: Paul uses "apostle" for more people than the Twelve: James (Galatians 1:19), Barnabas (9:5-6), Andronicus and Junia (Romans 16:7). "All" suggests a larger group than in verse 5, though which people are meant cannot be known.

decisions.choice: James, the Lord's brother
decisions.reason: Readable says which James is meant (m1), from Galatians 1:19.

source.text: ἔσχατον δὲ πάντων ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι ὤφθη κἀμοί.

records.literal_gloss: last but of all as if to the untimely birth he appeared also to me.

en.L: And last of all, as if to the untimely birth, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to me too.
en.B: Last of all, as though to a child born before its time, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to me as well.
en.R: Finally {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appeared to me too, though I was like a baby born at the wrong time.

fr.L: Et en dernier de tous, comme à l’avorton, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi.
fr.B: Et en tout dernier lieu, comme à un enfant né avant terme, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi.
fr.R: Enfin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’est apparu à moi aussi, alors que j’étais comme un bébé né au mauvais moment.

es.L: Y al último de todos, como al abortivo, se me apareció también a mí.
es.B: Por último, como a un niño nacido fuera de tiempo, se me apareció también a mí.
es.R: Al final se me apareció también a mí, aunque yo era como un bebé nacido a destiempo.

sw.L: Na mwisho wa wote, kana kwamba kwa yule aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati, alinitokea na mimi pia.
sw.B: Mwisho wa wote, alinitokea na mimi pia, kana kwamba kwa mtoto aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati wake.
sw.R: Mwishowe alinitokea na mimi pia, ingawa nilikuwa kama mtoto aliyezaliwa wakati usiofaa.

decisions.choice: untimely birth: a child born dead or too early, a picture of Paul's unfitness and of the abrupt, unnatural way he was made an apostle
alternatives: one born late, after the others
a term of abuse his opponents used of him ("freak")
decisions.reason: ἐκτρώματι means a miscarriage or stillborn child; the Greek Old Testament uses it that way (Numbers 12:12; Job 3:16). So the picture is of an unformed, abnormal birth rather than a late one. Verse 9 explains it: Paul was not fit to be an apostle. The article ("the untimely birth") may suggest a label others had used of him, but that cannot be shown.

decisions.choice: last of all: the appearance to Paul was the last of its kind, and of the same kind as the others
decisions.reason: Paul puts the risen Lord's appearance to him (9:1; Acts 9:3-6) in the same list as the appearances to Peter and the others, and at the end of it. This is the ground of his apostleship.

decisions.choice: a child born before its time (B); a baby born at the wrong time (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the picture in everyday words; Literal keeps "untimely birth".

decisions.choice: l’avorton (L); un enfant né avant terme (B)
decisions.reason: "Avorton" is the French word for a child born dead or too early, and like the Greek it can also be a word of contempt, which fits Paul's picture of his own unfitness (m1). Balanced gives the picture in everyday words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: el abortivo (L); un niño nacido fuera de tiempo (B); un bebé nacido a destiempo (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a child born dead or too early (m1). Literal keeps the hard Greek picture with "abortivo"; Balanced and Readable say a child born out of time, as the English does.

decisions.choice: aliyezaliwa kabla ya wakati
decisions.reason: A description rather than "njiti" (a premature baby, an everyday word that sounds affectionate) or "mimba iliyoharibika" (a miscarriage, which would narrow the picture); the meaning decision includes both a child born dead and one born too early.

source.text: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι ὁ ἐλάχιστος τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὃς οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς καλεῖσθαι ἀπόστολος, διότι ἐδίωξα τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: I for am the least of the apostles, who not am fit to be called apostle, because I persecuted the church of the God;

en.L: For I am the least of the apostles, who am not fit to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
en.B: Among the apostles I am the least; I am not even fit to bear the name apostle, because I persecuted God's church.
en.R: You see, I am the least important of the apostles. I am not good enough even to be called an apostle, because I used to attack God's church.

fr.L: Car moi, je suis le moindre des apôtres, moi qui ne suis pas apte à être appelé apôtre, parce que j’ai persécuté l’Église de Dieu.
fr.B: Parmi les apôtres, je suis le plus petit ; je ne suis même pas qualifié pour porter le nom d’apôtre, parce que j’ai persécuté l’Église de Dieu.
fr.R: Voyez-vous, je suis le moins important des apôtres. Je ne suis même pas assez bon pour qu’on m’appelle apôtre, parce qu’autrefois je m’en prenais à l’Église de Dieu.

es.L: Porque yo soy el menor de los apóstoles, que no soy digno de ser llamado apóstol, porque perseguí a la iglesia de Dios.
es.B: Entre los apóstoles yo soy el menor; ni siquiera soy digno de llevar el nombre de apóstol, porque perseguí a la iglesia de Dios.
es.R: Es que yo soy el menos importante de los apóstoles. Ni siquiera merezco que me llamen apóstol, porque antes atacaba a la iglesia de Dios.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ni mdogo kuliko mitume wote, nisiyestahili kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
sw.B: Miongoni mwa mitume mimi ni mdogo kabisa; sistahili hata kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
sw.R: Mimi ni mtume mdogo kuliko wote. Sifai hata kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu zamani nilikuwa nikilishambulia kanisa la Mungu.

decisions.choice: the least: lowest in standing, because of his past
decisions.reason: Paul does not say he did the least work; verse 10 says the opposite. He is least because of what he did before he met the Lord.

decisions.choice: fit: qualified, good enough
decisions.reason: ἱκανὸς means sufficient or qualified, as in 2 Corinthians 2:16 and 3:5-6, where Paul says his fitness comes from God.

decisions.choice: persecuted: Paul hunted down believers before his conversion
decisions.reason: Acts 8:3 and 9:1-2 describe it, and Paul speaks of it in Galatians 1:13 and Philippians 3:6.

decisions.choice: used to attack
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plainer verb and marks it as something in Paul's past.

decisions.choice: apte (L); qualifié (B)
decisions.reason: The word means qualified, good enough (m2), as in Colossians 1:12, where French also avoids "digne", which would turn the point into one of merit.

source.text: χάριτι δὲ θεοῦ εἰμι ὅ εἰμι, καὶ ἡ χάρις αὐτοῦ ἡ εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ κενὴ ἐγενήθη, ἀλλὰ περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων ἐκοπίασα, οὐκ ἐγὼ δὲ ἀλλὰ ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ σὺν ἐμοί.

records.literal_gloss: by grace but of God I am what I am, and the grace of him that toward me not empty became, but more than them all I labored, not I but but the grace of the God that [is] with me.

en.L: But by [the] grace of God I am what I am, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace toward me did not turn out empty; rather, I toiled more than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of God that [is] with me.
en.B: It is God's grace that has made me what I am, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace to me was not wasted. Instead, I have toiled harder than all of them, though it was not I but God's grace working with me.
en.R: But God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace made me what I am, and that grace was not wasted on me. In fact, I have worked harder than all the other apostles. Yet it was not really I who did it. It was God's grace, which was with me.

fr.L: Mais par la grâce de Dieu je suis ce que je suis, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce envers moi n’a pas été vaine ; au contraire, j’ai peiné plus qu’eux tous, non pas moi toutefois, mais la grâce de Dieu qui [est] avec moi.
fr.B: C’est la grâce de Dieu qui a fait de moi ce que je suis, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce envers moi n’a pas été perdue. Au contraire, je me suis donné plus de peine qu’eux tous, ou plutôt non pas moi, mais la grâce de Dieu qui agit avec moi.
fr.R: Mais Dieu, dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, a fait de moi ce que je suis, et cette grâce n’a pas été gaspillée. En fait, j’ai travaillé plus dur que tous les autres apôtres. Pourtant, ce n’est pas vraiment moi qui l’ai fait. C’est la grâce de Dieu, qui était avec moi.

es.L: Pero por [la] gracia de Dios soy lo que soy, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para conmigo no resultó vacía; antes bien, he trabajado más que todos ellos, aunque no yo, sino la gracia de Dios que [está] conmigo.
es.B: Es la gracia de Dios la que me ha hecho lo que soy, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para conmigo no fue en vano. Al contrario, he trabajado más duro que todos ellos, aunque no fui yo, sino la gracia de Dios que actuaba conmigo.
es.R: Pero Dios, por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, me hizo lo que soy, y esa gracia no se desperdició en mí. De hecho, he trabajado más duro que todos los demás apóstoles. Pero en realidad no lo hice yo. Fue la gracia de Dios, que estaba conmigo.

sw.L: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu mimi ni hivi nilivyo, na neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwangu haikuwa bure; bali nilifanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko wote hao, lakini si mimi, bali neema ya Mungu [iliyo] pamoja nami.
sw.B: Ni neema ya Mungu iliyonifanya kuwa hivi nilivyo, na neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwangu haikupotea bure. Badala yake, nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko wote hao, ingawa si mimi, bali ni neema ya Mungu iliyofanya kazi pamoja nami.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu kwa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} amenifanya kuwa hivi nilivyo, na neema hiyo haikupotea bure kwangu. Kwa kweli, nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuliko mitume wengine wote. Lakini si mimi hasa niliyefanya hivyo. Ilikuwa neema ya Mungu, iliyokuwa pamoja nami.

decisions.choice: grace: God's undeserved favor, and the power at work in Paul
decisions.reason: χάριτι, χάρις and χάρις are the same word three times. Set against verse 9, it is favor Paul did nothing to earn. By the third time it is something active: the grace "with" him does the work.

decisions.choice: empty: without result
decisions.reason: κενὴ is the word Paul uses in verse 14 for preaching and faith that would be empty if Christ were not raised, and in verse 58 for work that is not in vain.

decisions.choice: more than all of them: either more than any one apostle or more than all of them together
decisions.reason: περισσότερον αὐτῶν πάντων can be read either way; the translation keeps both open.

decisions.choice: not I but grace: Paul does not deny his own effort, but gives the credit for it to God
decisions.reason: He has just said that he toiled. He then corrects himself, as in Galatians 2:20 and Philippians 2:12-13: the work was his, and yet it was God's grace working in him.

decisions.choice: God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace made me what I am
alternatives: by the grace of God I am what I am
decisions.reason: Readable makes God the subject so that the sentence is easy to follow.

source.text: εἴτε οὖν ἐγὼ εἴτε ἐκεῖνοι, οὕτως κηρύσσομεν καὶ οὕτως ἐπιστεύσατε.

records.literal_gloss: whether then I or those, so we proclaim and so you believed.

en.L: Whether then [it was] I or they, so we proclaim and so you believed.
en.B: In any case, whether it came from me or from them, this is the message we all proclaim, and this is the message you believed.
en.R: So it does not matter whether you heard it from me or from the other apostles. We all preach the same message, and it is this message that you believed.

fr.L: Que ce soit donc moi, que ce soit eux, ainsi nous proclamons et ainsi vous avez cru.
fr.B: Quoi qu’il en soit, que le message vienne de moi ou d’eux, c’est là ce que nous proclamons tous, et c’est là ce que vous avez cru.
fr.R: Peu importe donc que vous l’ayez entendu de moi ou des autres apôtres. Nous annonçons tous le même message, et c’est ce message que vous avez cru.

es.L: Sea, pues, yo o ellos, así predicamos y así {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}.
es.B: En todo caso, sea que venga de mí o de ellos, este es el mensaje que todos predicamos, y este es el mensaje que {{plural_you:ustedes creyeron|vosotros creísteis}}.
es.R: Así que no importa si lo {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} de mí o de los otros apóstoles. Todos predicamos el mismo mensaje, y es este mensaje el que {{plural_you:ustedes creyeron|vosotros creísteis}}.

sw.L: Basi, ikiwa ni mimi au ni wao, ndivyo tunavyohubiri na ndivyo mlivyoamini.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, iwe ujumbe ulitoka kwangu au kwao, huu ndio ujumbe tunaohubiri sote, na huu ndio ujumbe mlioamini.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo haijalishi kama mliusikia kutoka kwangu au kutoka kwa mitume wengine. Sote tunahubiri ujumbe ule ule, na ni ujumbe huu mlioamini.

decisions.choice: they: the other apostles and witnesses just named
decisions.reason: ἐκεῖνοι looks back to Cephas, the Twelve, James and the apostles in verses 5-7.

decisions.choice: so: this same message, the one set out in verses 3-5
decisions.reason: οὕτως and οὕτως point back to the gospel just summed up. All the apostles proclaim it, and the Corinthians believed it, which prepares the question of verse 12.

decisions.choice: this is the message we all proclaim
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "so" points to (m2).

source.text: Εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς κηρύσσεται ὅτι ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγήγερται, πῶς λέγουσιν ἐν ὑμῖν τινες ὅτι ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν;

records.literal_gloss: If but Christ is proclaimed that from dead he has been raised, how say among you some that resurrection of dead not is?

en.L: Now if {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} is proclaimed, that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised from [the] dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of [the] dead?
en.B: Now if what we proclaim about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been raised from the dead, how can some among you be saying there is no such thing as a resurrection of the dead?
en.R: We proclaim that God has raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from the dead. So how can some of you say that the dead will never rise?

fr.L: Or si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est proclamé, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité d’entre les morts, comment certains parmi vous disent-ils qu’il n’y a pas de résurrection des morts ?
fr.B: Mais si ce que nous proclamons au sujet du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, c’est qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité d’entre les morts, comment certains parmi vous peuvent-ils dire que la résurrection des morts n’existe pas ?
fr.R: Nous annonçons que Dieu a ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} d’entre les morts. Alors comment certains d’entre vous peuvent-ils dire que les morts ne ressusciteront jamais ?

es.L: Pero si se predica de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} que ha sido resucitado de entre [los] muertos, ¿cómo dicen algunos entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que no hay resurrección de [los] muertos?
es.B: Ahora bien, si lo que predicamos acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} es que ha sido resucitado de entre los muertos, ¿cómo pueden decir algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que no existe la resurrección de los muertos?
es.R: Nosotros predicamos que Dios resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} de entre los muertos. Entonces, ¿cómo pueden decir algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que los muertos nunca van a resucitar?

sw.L: Basi ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anahubiriwa kwamba amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, mbona baadhi yenu wanasema kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu?
sw.B: Basi ikiwa tunachohubiri juu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni kwamba amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, inawezekanaje baadhi yenu kusema kwamba hakuna kitu kama ufufuo wa wafu?
sw.R: Tunahubiri kwamba Mungu amemfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kutoka kwa wafu. Basi baadhi yenu wanawezaje kusema kwamba wafu hawatafufuka kamwe?

decisions.choice: if: a condition Paul takes as true, since Christ is in fact proclaimed
decisions.reason: Εἰ begins a chain of conditions that runs to verse 19. Here the "if" states what both sides accept; the following conditions draw out what the denial would mean.

decisions.choice: no resurrection of the dead: some at Corinth denied that dead people will be raised
decisions.reason: Paul does not say exactly what they believed. They may have held that the resurrection had already happened in a spiritual sense (compare 2 Timothy 2:18), or have found the idea of a raised body absurd, as verses 35-49 suggest. Either way they did not deny that Christ was raised, and Paul shows that the two stand or fall together.

decisions.choice: from the dead: from among dead people
decisions.reason: νεκρῶν is plural: Christ was raised out from among the dead. That is the link Paul uses: if one dead person has been raised, the dead can be raised.

decisions.choice: there is no such thing as a resurrection of the dead
alternatives: there is no resurrection of the dead
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the full force of the flat denial.

decisions.choice: God has raised
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who raised him, as Paul does in verse 15.

decisions.choice: ufufuo wa wafu, kufufuliwa (L, B); wafu kufufuka (R)
decisions.reason: "Ufufuo" (resurrection) and the passive "kufufuliwa" (be raised) at Literal and Balanced, as the English; Readable uses the intransitive "kufufuka" (rise) where the English Readable says the dead "rise", and names God where he is the one who raises.

source.text: εἰ δὲ ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔστιν, οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται·

records.literal_gloss: if but resurrection of dead not is, neither Christ has been raised;

en.L: But if there is no resurrection of [the] dead, not even {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has been raised.
en.B: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has not been raised either.
en.R: If the dead do not rise, then God has not raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} either.

fr.L: Mais s’il n’y a pas de résurrection des morts, pas même le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a été ressuscité.
fr.B: S’il n’y a pas de résurrection des morts, alors le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité non plus.
fr.R: Si les morts ne ressuscitent pas, alors Dieu n’a pas non plus ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Pero si no hay resurrección de [los] muertos, tampoco {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} ha sido resucitado.
es.B: Si no hay resurrección de los muertos, entonces tampoco {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} ha sido resucitado.
es.R: Si los muertos no resucitan, entonces Dios tampoco resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, hata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa.
sw.B: Ikiwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, basi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} naye hajafufuliwa.
sw.R: Ikiwa wafu hawafufuki, basi Mungu hajamfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia.

decisions.choice: if there is none, then not even Christ: the general denial takes in Christ as well
decisions.reason: If no dead person can be raised, then Christ, who died, cannot have been. This is the first link in the chain that runs to verse 19. ἐγήγερται is again the perfect, "has been raised", as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: God has not raised
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, Readable names God as the one who raises.

source.text: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται, κενὸν ἄρα τὸ κήρυγμα ἡμῶν, κενὴ καὶ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, εὑρισκόμεθα δὲ καὶ ψευδομάρτυρες τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅτι ἐμαρτυρήσαμεν κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι ἤγειρεν τὸν Χριστόν, ὃν οὐκ ἤγειρεν εἴπερ ἄρα νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται.

records.literal_gloss: if but Christ not has been raised, empty then the proclamation of us, empty also the faith of you, \v 15 we are found but also false witnesses of the God, because we testified against the God that he raised the Christ, whom not he raised if indeed then dead not are raised.

en.L: And if {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has not been raised, then our proclamation [is] empty, and your faith [is] also empty, \v 15 and we are even found [to be] false witnesses of God, because we testified against God that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not raise if after all [the] dead are not raised.
en.B: And if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has not been raised, then what we proclaim is empty, and your faith is empty too. \v 15 Worse, we turn out to be giving false evidence about God, since we have borne witness against God by saying {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not raise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, if it is really so that the dead are not raised.
en.R: And if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has not been raised, then our preaching is worth nothing, and so is your faith. \v 15 Even worse, we who preach would be telling lies about God. We have told everyone that God raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from death. But if it is true that the dead do not rise, then God did not raise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, alors notre proclamation [est] vaine, et votre foi aussi [est] vaine, \v 15 et nous sommes même trouvés faux témoins de Dieu, parce que nous avons témoigné contre Dieu qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas ressuscité si vraiment les morts ne sont pas ressuscités.
fr.B: Et si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, alors ce que nous proclamons est vide, et votre foi aussi est vide. \v 15 Pire encore, nous nous révélons de faux témoins de Dieu, puisque nous avons témoigné contre Dieu en disant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, alors qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a pas ressuscité, s’il est vrai que les morts ne sont pas ressuscités.
fr.R: Et si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, notre prédication ne vaut rien, et votre foi non plus. \v 15 Pire encore, nous qui prêchons, nous serions en train de mentir au sujet de Dieu. Nous avons dit à tout le monde que Dieu a ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} d’entre les morts. Mais s’il est vrai que les morts ne ressuscitent pas, alors Dieu ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a pas ressuscité.

es.L: Y si {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, entonces nuestra predicación [es] vacía, y vacía también {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}}, \v 15 y aun somos hallados falsos testigos de Dios, porque testificamos contra Dios que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} resucitó al {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, al cual no resucitó si en verdad los muertos no son resucitados.
es.B: Y si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, lo que predicamos no tiene contenido, y {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}} tampoco. \v 15 Peor aún, resultamos ser falsos testigos acerca de Dios, porque hemos dado testimonio contra Dios al decir que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, cuando no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó, si de verdad los muertos no son resucitados.
es.R: Y si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, nuestra predicación no vale nada, y {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}} tampoco. \v 15 Peor todavía, los que predicamos estaríamos diciendo mentiras acerca de Dios. Hemos dicho a todos que Dios resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} de la muerte. Pero si es verdad que los muertos no resucitan, entonces Dios no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó.

sw.L: Na ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, basi mahubiri yetu [ni] bure, na imani yenu pia [ni] bure, \v 15 na zaidi tunaonekana [kuwa] mashahidi wa uongo wa Mungu, kwa sababu tulishuhudia dhidi ya Mungu kwamba alimfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ambaye hakumfufua ikiwa kweli wafu hawafufuliwi.
sw.B: Na ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, basi tunachohubiri ni bure, na imani yenu pia ni bure. \v 15 Zaidi ya hayo, tunaonekana kuwa tunatoa ushahidi wa uongo juu ya Mungu, kwa kuwa tumeshuhudia dhidi ya Mungu kwa kusema kwamba alimfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, wakati hakumfufua, ikiwa ni kweli kwamba wafu hawafufuliwi.
sw.R: Na ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, basi mahubiri yetu hayana thamani, na imani yenu vilevile. \v 15 Zaidi ya hayo, sisi tunaohubiri tungekuwa tunasema uongo juu ya Mungu. Tumewaambia watu wote kwamba Mungu alimfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kutoka kwa wafu. Lakini ikiwa ni kweli kwamba wafu hawafufuki, basi Mungu hakumfufua.

decisions.choice: empty: without content and without result
decisions.reason: κενὸν and κενὴ are the word used of grace in verse 10. Preaching about a Christ who was not raised would have nothing in it, and faith resting on it would have nothing to rest on.

decisions.choice: false witnesses of God: people who give false testimony about God
alternatives: false witnesses who claim to be sent by God
decisions.reason: The phrase is explained by what follows: they have testified that God did something he did not do.

decisions.choice: against God: to say falsely that God did something is to testify against him
decisions.reason: κατὰ with this case usually means "against". Paul uses the strong sense: a false claim about God's act would be testimony against God himself.

decisions.choice: he raised: God is the one who raised Christ
decisions.reason: ἤγειρεν makes plain who is behind the passive "has been raised" in verses 4, 12-14 and 20.

decisions.choice: we who preach ... told everyone
decisions.reason: Readable says who "we" are (the preachers of verse 11) and what their testimony was.

decisions.choice: al {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article here, "the Christ", and Literal keeps it, as the English "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}"; Spanish contracts "a el" to "al" before either word.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται, οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται·

records.literal_gloss: if for dead not are raised, neither Christ has been raised;

en.L: For if [the] dead are not raised, not even {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has been raised.
en.B: For if dead people are not raised, neither has {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} been raised.
en.R: So if the dead do not rise, then God has not raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} either.

fr.L: Car si les morts ne sont pas ressuscités, pas même le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a été ressuscité.
fr.B: Car si les morts ne sont pas ressuscités, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité non plus.
fr.R: Donc, si les morts ne ressuscitent pas, alors Dieu n’a pas non plus ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

es.L: Porque si [los] muertos no son resucitados, tampoco {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} ha sido resucitado.
es.B: Porque si los muertos no son resucitados, tampoco {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} ha sido resucitado.
es.R: Así que, si los muertos no resucitan, entonces Dios tampoco resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi, hata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa.
sw.B: Kwa maana ikiwa wafu hawafufuliwi, basi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} naye hajafufuliwa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ikiwa wafu hawafufuki, basi Mungu hajamfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia.

decisions.choice: for if the dead are not raised: Paul restates verse 13 to start the chain again
decisions.reason: ἐγείρονται is present tense, stating a general rule: the dead are never raised. Verses 16-18 repeat the logic of 13-15 and carry it further, to the believers' sins and to those who have died.

decisions.choice: God has not raised
decisions.reason: As in verses 12-13, Readable names God as the one who raises.

source.text: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται, ματαία ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, ἔτι ἐστὲ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: if but Christ not has been raised, futile the faith of you, still you are in the sins of you.

en.L: But if {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has not been raised, useless [is] your faith; still you are in your sins.
en.B: But if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has not been raised, your faith is worthless, and you are still in your sins.
en.R: And if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has not been raised, your faith is useless. Your sins are still counted against you.

fr.L: Mais si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, inutile [est] votre foi ; vous êtes encore dans vos péchés.
fr.B: Mais si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, votre foi est sans valeur, et vous êtes encore dans vos péchés.
fr.R: Et si le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas été ressuscité, votre foi ne sert à rien. Vos péchés sont toujours retenus contre vous.

es.L: Pero si {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, inútil [es] {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}}; todavía {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.B: Pero si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}} no sirve de nada, y todavía {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.
es.R: Y si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no ha sido resucitado, {{plural_you:la fe de ustedes|vuestra fe}} es inútil. Todavía {{plural_you:se les toman|se os toman}} en cuenta {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, imani yenu [ni] batili; mngali katika dhambi zenu.
sw.B: Lakini ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, imani yenu haina maana, nanyi bado mko katika dhambi zenu.
sw.R: Na ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hajafufuliwa, imani yenu haina faida yoyote. Dhambi zenu bado zinahesabiwa juu yenu.

decisions.choice: futile: achieving nothing
decisions.reason: ματαία differs a little from "empty" in verse 14: there faith had nothing in it; here it gets nothing done. It cannot free them from their sins.

decisions.choice: still in your sins: unforgiven, still under sin's guilt
decisions.reason: Christ died "for our sins" (verse 3), and his being raised shows that his death has done its work (Romans 4:25). Without the resurrection, his death would have left their sins where they were.

decisions.choice: Your sins are still counted against you
alternatives: you are still in your sins
decisions.reason: Readable says what being "in" one's sins means (m2).

source.text: ἄρα καὶ οἱ κοιμηθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ ἀπώλοντο.

records.literal_gloss: then also those having fallen asleep in Christ perished.

en.L: Then also those who fell asleep in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} perished.
en.B: It would also mean that those who have died in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} have perished.
en.R: It would also mean that people who died trusting in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} are lost forever.

fr.L: Alors aussi ceux qui se sont endormis {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} ont péri.
fr.B: Cela voudrait dire aussi que ceux qui sont morts {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} ont péri.
fr.R: Cela voudrait dire aussi que ceux qui sont morts unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} sont perdus pour toujours.

es.L: Entonces también los que se durmieron en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} perecieron.
es.B: Eso también significaría que los que han muerto en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} están perdidos.
es.R: También significaría que los que murieron confiando en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} están perdidos para siempre.

sw.L: Basi pia wale waliolala katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wamepotea.
sw.B: Hiyo ingemaanisha pia kwamba wale waliofariki wakiwa ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wameangamia.
sw.R: Hiyo ingemaanisha pia kwamba watu waliokufa wakimtumaini {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wamepotea milele.

decisions.choice: fallen asleep: died
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, 7:39 and 11:30. The image of sleep implies waking; if there is no resurrection, the image is empty.

decisions.choice: in Christ: belonging to Christ, united with him when they died
decisions.reason: ἐν Χριστῷ describes believers who died, as "the dead in Christ" does in 1 Thessalonians 4:16.

decisions.choice: perished: lost and ruined beyond hope, not simply dead
decisions.reason: ἀπώλοντο is the verb used in 1:18 of "those who are perishing". If Christ was not raised, those who trusted him have no future at all.

decisions.choice: have died; died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m1), as in verse 6; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: trusting in; lost forever
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ" and "perished" mean here (m2, m3).

source.text: εἰ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ ταύτῃ ἐν Χριστῷ ἠλπικότες ἐσμὲν μόνον, ἐλεεινότεροι πάντων ἀνθρώπων ἐσμέν.

records.literal_gloss: if in the life this in Christ having hoped we are only, more pitiable than all people we are.

en.L: If in this life we have hoped in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, and only [that], we are more pitiable than all {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: If our hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} reaches no further than this life, no one is more to be pitied than we are.
en.R: If our hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is only for this life, then people should feel sorrier for us than for anyone else.

fr.L: Si dans cette vie nous avons espéré {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, et seulement [cela], nous sommes les plus à plaindre de tous {{gender:les humains|les hommes}}.
fr.B: Si notre espérance {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} ne va pas plus loin que cette vie, personne n’est plus à plaindre que nous.
fr.R: Si notre espérance dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne vaut que pour cette vie, alors les gens devraient avoir plus pitié de nous que de n’importe qui d’autre.

es.L: Si solo en esta vida hemos esperado en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, somos los más dignos de lástima de {{gender:todos los seres humanos|todos los hombres}}.
es.B: Si nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} no va más allá de esta vida, nadie es más digno de lástima que nosotros.
es.R: Si nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} es solo para esta vida, la gente debería tenernos más lástima que a nadie.

sw.L: Ikiwa katika maisha haya tumemtumaini {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na hilo tu, sisi ni wa kuhurumiwa kuliko watu wote.
sw.B: Ikiwa tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} haliendi zaidi ya maisha haya, hakuna mtu wa kuhurumiwa kuliko sisi.
sw.R: Ikiwa tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni kwa ajili ya maisha haya tu, basi watu wanapaswa kutuhurumia kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote.

decisions.choice: only: a hope that goes no further than this life
alternatives: if hoping is all we have done, with nothing to hope for
decisions.reason: μόνον stands at the end of the clause and could limit the whole of it. Read with ἐν τῇ ζωῇ ταύτῃ ("in this life"), it means a hope that ends at death, which fits verses 18 and 32.

decisions.choice: we have hoped: a settled hope placed in Christ
decisions.reason: ἠλπικότες ἐσμὲν is a perfect: they have set their hope on Christ and it stays there.

decisions.choice: more pitiable: more to be pitied, because they have given up so much for a hope that would be false
decisions.reason: Verses 30-32 show what Paul has given up and risked. If the hope ends at death, all of that was for nothing.

decisions.choice: no one is more to be pitied than we are
alternatives: we are more pitiable than all people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the comparison in natural English order.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todos los seres humanos|todos los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As in 7:7: the Greek word means all human beings, and the English has a gender span here.

decisions.choice: maisha haya
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word for life means this present lifetime, so it is "maisha"; the key term "uzima" is kept for life itself, the life God gives (style guide).

source.text: Νυνὶ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἀπαρχὴ τῶν κεκοιμημένων.

records.literal_gloss: Now but Christ has been raised from dead, firstfruits of those having fallen asleep.

en.L: But now {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has been raised from [the] dead, [the] firstfruits of those who sleep.
en.B: But as it is, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has been raised from the dead: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the firstfruits of those who have died.
en.R: But {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} truly has been raised from the dead. He is the firstfruits, like the first part of a harvest, and those who have died will follow {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as the rest of the harvest.

fr.L: Mais maintenant le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a été ressuscité d’entre les morts, [les] prémices de ceux qui se sont endormis.
fr.B: Mais en réalité, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a été ressuscité d’entre les morts : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est les prémices de ceux qui sont morts.
fr.R: Mais le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a vraiment été ressuscité d’entre les morts. Il est les prémices, comme la première part de la récolte, et ceux qui sont morts {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivront comme le reste de la récolte.

es.L: Pero ahora {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} ha sido resucitado de entre [los] muertos, primicias de los que duermen.
es.B: Pero la realidad es que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} ha sido resucitado de entre los muertos: {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es las primicias de los que han muerto.
es.R: Pero {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} de verdad ha sido resucitado de entre los muertos. Él es las primicias, como la primera parte de una cosecha, y los que han muerto {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguirán como el resto de la cosecha.

sw.L: Lakini sasa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, malimbuko ya wale waliolala.
sw.B: Lakini kwa kweli {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Yeye ni malimbuko ya wale waliofariki.
sw.R: Lakini kwa kweli {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Yeye ni malimbuko, kama sehemu ya kwanza ya mavuno, na wale waliokufa watamfuata kama mavuno yote yaliyobaki.

decisions.choice: but now: as things really are
decisions.reason: Νυνὶ δὲ marks the turn from the false supposition of verses 13-19 to the fact. Paul again uses the perfect, "has been raised".

decisions.choice: firstfruits: the first part of the harvest, given to God, which promised the rest
decisions.reason: Israel brought the first sheaf of the barley harvest to the priest to be offered to God before the rest was gathered (Leviticus 23:9-14). The first part belongs to the whole harvest and shows that the rest will come. Christ's being raised is the start of the resurrection of all who belong to him (verse 23). The sheaf was offered in the days after Passover, the time of Jesus' death and resurrection, but Paul does not draw out that link.

decisions.choice: those who have fallen asleep: believers who have died
decisions.reason: As in verses 6 and 18. κεκοιμημένων is a perfect: they have died and remain in death, waiting to be raised.

decisions.choice: those who have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the idiom (m3), as in verses 6 and 18; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: like the first part of a harvest ... will follow {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as the rest of the harvest
alternatives: the firstfruits of those who have died
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: primicias
decisions.reason: "Primicias" is the Spanish word for the first part of the harvest offered to God (m2), as in Romans 8:23, 11:16 and James 1:18; Readable explains it, as the English does. Verse 23 keeps it.

decisions.choice: malimbuko
decisions.reason: "Malimbuko" is the first part of the harvest, given to God, which promised the rest (meaning decision), the word Swahili Revelation 14:4 uses; Readable explains it as the English Readable does. The same word in verse 23.

source.text: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ δι’ ἀνθρώπου θάνατος, καὶ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν·

records.literal_gloss: since for through a human being death, also through a human being resurrection of dead;

en.L: For since through a human being [came] death, also through a human being [comes the] resurrection of [the] dead.
en.B: For since death came by way of a human being, the resurrection of the dead also comes by way of a human being.
en.R: Death came through one human being, Adam. And rising from the dead comes through another human being, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

fr.L: Car puisque par un être humain [est venue] la mort, par un être humain aussi [vient la] résurrection des morts.
fr.B: Car puisque la mort est venue par un être humain, c’est aussi par un être humain que vient la résurrection des morts.
fr.R: La mort est venue par un être humain, Adam. Et c’est par un autre être humain, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, que les morts reviennent à la vie.

es.L: Porque ya que por un ser humano [vino la] muerte, también por un ser humano [viene la] resurrección de [los] muertos.
es.B: Porque, así como la muerte vino por medio de un ser humano, también la resurrección de los muertos viene por medio de un ser humano.
es.R: La muerte vino por medio de un ser humano, Adán. Y la resurrección de los muertos viene por medio de otro ser humano, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa kuwa kifo [kilikuja] kupitia mwanadamu, ufufuo wa wafu pia [unakuja] kupitia mwanadamu.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa kifo kilikuja kupitia mwanadamu, ufufuo wa wafu nao unakuja kupitia mwanadamu.
sw.R: Kifo kilikuja kupitia mwanadamu mmoja, Adamu. Na kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu kunakuja kupitia mwanadamu mwingine, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

decisions.choice: a human being: Adam in the first case, Christ in the second, each a human being
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώπου and ἀνθρώπου mean a human being. The point is that both death and resurrection came through someone human; for Christ, it stresses that he shares our humanity. Each refers to one particular person, so no inclusive setting applies.

decisions.choice: came ... comes: the verbs are left out in the Greek
decisions.reason: The sentence has no verbs. Death came through Adam in the past; resurrection comes through Christ, begun in him and still to come for others (verses 22-23).

decisions.choice: the two human beings: Adam brought death, Christ brings life
decisions.reason: Paul makes the same comparison at length in Romans 5:12-21, and again in verses 45-49 of this chapter.

decisions.choice: a human being
decisions.reason: "A human being" keeps the stress on humanity (m1). Readable says the same.

decisions.choice: Adam; {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable names the two people, as verse 22 does.

decisions.choice: un ser humano
decisions.reason: The Greek word means a human being (m1), and the point is that both Adam and Christ are human; "ser humano" says it without a gender setting, as the English "a human being".

decisions.choice: mwanadamu
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" (a human being) for both Adam and Christ, as the English "a human being", so that Christ's full humanity is plain; it carries no gender span, being already inclusive.

source.text: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐν τῷ Ἀδὰμ πάντες ἀποθνῄσκουσιν, οὕτως καὶ ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ πάντες ζῳοποιηθήσονται.

records.literal_gloss: as for in the Adam all die, so also in the Christ all will be made alive.

en.L: For just as in Adam all die, so also in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} all will be made alive.
en.B: Just as all who belong to Adam die, so all who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will be brought to life.
en.R: All people die because they are joined to Adam. In the same way, all who are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will be brought to life.

fr.L: Car de même qu’en Adam tous meurent, de même aussi dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} tous seront rendus vivants.
fr.B: De même que tous ceux qui appartiennent à Adam meurent, de même tous ceux qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} seront rendus à la vie.
fr.R: Tout le monde meurt, parce que tous sont liés à Adam. De la même manière, tous ceux qui sont liés au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} seront ramenés à la vie.

es.L: Porque así como en Adán todos mueren, así también en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} todos serán vivificados.
es.B: Así como todos los que pertenecen a Adán mueren, así también todos los que pertenecen {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} recibirán vida.
es.R: Todas las personas mueren porque están unidas a Adán. De la misma manera, todos los que están unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} recibirán vida.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile katika Adamu wote wanakufa, vivyo hivyo pia katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wote watahuishwa.
sw.B: Kama vile wote walio wa Adamu wanakufa, vivyo hivyo wote walio wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} watafanywa hai.
sw.R: Watu wote wanakufa kwa sababu wameunganishwa na Adamu. Vivyo hivyo, wote walioungana na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} watafanywa hai.

decisions.choice: in Adam ... in Christ: all who are united with Adam die; all who are united with Christ will be made alive
alternatives: all people without exception will be made alive
decisions.reason: "In" names belonging to a head. Everyone belongs to Adam; verse 23 says that those made alive are "those who belong to Christ", at his coming. So the second "all" is everyone in Christ.

decisions.choice: will be made alive: raised to life at the resurrection
decisions.reason: ζῳοποιηθήσονται is future and looks to the resurrection at Christ's coming (verse 23), not the new life believers have now.

decisions.choice: all who belong to; joined to
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "in" means here (m1).

decisions.choice: serán vivificados
decisions.reason: The verb means to be made alive, raised to life at the resurrection (m2). Literal keeps "vivificar"; Balanced and Readable say "recibir vida".

decisions.choice: watahuishwa (L); watafanywa hai (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal "kuhuisha" (make alive), the verb used again for the life-giving Spirit in verse 45, so the link is kept; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

source.text: ἕκαστος δὲ ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ τάγματι· ἀπαρχὴ Χριστός, ἔπειτα οἱ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: each but in the own order; firstfruits Christ, then those of the Christ at the coming of him;

en.L: But each one in [their] own order: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [the] firstfruits, then those who are the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}'s at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming.
en.B: But each has a set place in the sequence: first {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the firstfruits; after that, at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming, the people who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}.
en.R: But it happens in the right order. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} was raised first, as the firstfruits. Then, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes back, the people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} will be raised.

fr.L: Mais chacun dans son propre rang : le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [comme] prémices, ensuite ceux du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, lors de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue.
fr.B: Mais chacun à la place qui lui revient : d’abord le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, les prémices ; ensuite, lors de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent.
fr.R: Mais tout se passe dans le bon ordre. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a été ressuscité le premier, comme les prémices. Ensuite, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent seront ressuscités.

es.L: Pero cada uno en su propio orden: {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, [las] primicias; luego los que son del {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida.
es.B: Pero cada uno tiene su lugar en el orden: primero {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, las primicias; después, en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida, los que son {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}.
es.R: Pero esto sucede en el debido orden. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} resucitó primero, como las primicias. Después, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vuelva, resucitarán los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen.

sw.L: Lakini kila mmoja katika mpangilio wake mwenyewe: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [ni] malimbuko, kisha wale walio wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wakati wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Lakini kila mmoja ana nafasi yake katika mpangilio: kwanza {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, malimbuko; baadaye, wakati wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, wale walio {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Lakini mambo haya yanatokea kwa mpangilio unaofaa. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alifufuliwa kwanza, kama malimbuko. Kisha, atakaporudi, watu walio {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watafufuliwa.

decisions.choice: order: a place in a sequence
decisions.reason: τάγματι was used of a rank or unit of soldiers. Here the point is sequence: Christ first, then those who are his.

decisions.choice: coming: Christ's arrival at the end
decisions.reason: παρουσίᾳ means presence or arrival. Paul uses it of the arrival of friends (16:17; 2 Corinthians 7:6), and of the Lord's coming (1 Thessalonians 2:19; 4:15). The word was also used for the visit of a ruler.

decisions.choice: those of Christ: the people who belong to Christ
decisions.reason: Paul speaks here only of believers being raised; he does not discuss others in this chapter.

decisions.choice: was raised first; will be raised
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the verb the Greek leaves out.

decisions.choice: venida
decisions.reason: "Venida" is the settled word for Christ's coming at the end (m2); Readable says "cuando él vuelva", as the English "comes back".

decisions.choice: kuja kwake
decisions.reason: "Kuja" (coming) is the settled New Testament word for this Greek word; the possessive of the verbal noun is "kwake", which takes the span as a free pronoun.

source.text: εἶτα τὸ τέλος, ὅταν παραδιδῷ τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρί, ὅταν καταργήσῃ πᾶσαν ἀρχὴν καὶ πᾶσαν ἐξουσίαν καὶ δύναμιν, δεῖ γὰρ αὐτὸν βασιλεύειν ἄχρι οὗ θῇ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: then the end, when he hands over the kingdom to the God and Father, when he does away with all rule and all authority and power. \v 25 It is necessary for him to reign until which he puts all the enemies under the feet of him.

en.L: Then [comes] the end, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hands over the kingdom to God, even [the] Father, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done away with every rule and every authority and power. \v 25 For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} must reign until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put all the enemies under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.B: After that comes the end, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hands the kingdom over to God the Father, once {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put an end to every ruler, every authority and every power. \v 25 For {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} reign must continue until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has placed all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies beneath {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.
en.R: Then the end will come. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} will give the kingdom to God the Father, once {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put an end to every ruler, every authority and every power that opposes God. \v 25 For {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} must rule as king until all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies have been put under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.

fr.L: Ensuite [vient] la fin, lorsqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remet le royaume à Dieu le Père, lorsqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a aboli toute principauté et toute autorité et puissance. \v 25 Car il faut qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} règne jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait mis tous les ennemis sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.B: Après cela viendra la fin, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remettra le royaume à Dieu le Père, après avoir mis fin à toute principauté, à toute autorité et à toute puissance. \v 25 Car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} règne doit durer jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait placé tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Ensuite, la fin viendra. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} remettra le royaume à Dieu le Père, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura mis fin à tous les chefs, à toutes les autorités et à toutes les puissances qui s’opposent à Dieu. \v 25 Car le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} doit régner comme roi jusqu’à ce que tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis aient été mis sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

es.L: Luego [vendrá] el fin, cuando entregue el reino a Dios, el Padre, cuando haya destruido todo dominio y toda autoridad y poder. \v 25 Porque es necesario que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reine hasta que haya puesto a todos los enemigos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.B: Después vendrá el fin, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entregue el reino a Dios el Padre, una vez que haya puesto fin a todo gobernante, a toda autoridad y a todo poder. \v 25 Porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reinado debe continuar hasta que haya puesto a todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.
es.R: Entonces llegará el fin. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} entregará el reino a Dios el Padre, cuando haya puesto fin a todo gobernante, a toda autoridad y a todo poder que se opone a Dios. \v 25 Porque {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} tiene que reinar hasta que todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos hayan sido puestos debajo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.

sw.L: Kisha [unakuja] mwisho, atakapomkabidhi Mungu, yaani Baba, ufalme, atakapokuwa amebatilisha kila utawala na kila mamlaka na nguvu. \v 25 Kwa maana ni lazima {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawale mpaka atakapowaweka maadui wote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Baadaye unakuja mwisho, atakapomkabidhi Mungu Baba ufalme, baada ya kukomesha kila mtawala, kila mamlaka na kila nguvu. \v 25 Kwa maana utawala {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} lazima uendelee mpaka atakapowaweka maadui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Kisha mwisho utakuja. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atampa Mungu Baba ufalme, baada ya kukomesha kila mtawala, kila mamlaka na kila nguvu inayompinga Mungu. \v 25 Kwa maana {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} lazima atawale kama mfalme mpaka maadui {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote watakapowekwa chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

decisions.choice: he hands over, he does away with, he must reign: Christ
decisions.reason: Christ is the subject from verse 23, and he hands the kingdom to God the Father.

decisions.choice: until he has put: most naturally Christ, continuing the subject; under his feet: Christ's
alternatives: God puts the enemies under Christ's feet, as in Psalm 110:1, where God speaks to the king
decisions.reason: The subject of θῇ is not stated. The run of the sentence points to Christ; the Psalm and verse 27, where God subjects all things to Christ, point to God. Either way the enemies end up under Christ's feet.

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:1
decisions.reason: In Psalm 110:1 the LORD (the divine name in the Hebrew) says to the king, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." Paul alludes to it in his own words, and joins the phrase "under his feet" from Psalm 8:7, which he quotes in verse 27.

decisions.choice: rule, authority, power: the powers, seen and unseen, that oppose God
decisions.reason: The same words name hostile powers in 2:6-8, Ephesians 1:21 and Colossians 2:15. Here they are among the "enemies" of verse 25.
